representation: Existing v2 title-newline-passage embeddings; no new embedding inputs
candidate: Rank eligible current runbooks by their closest passage distance, ties by that passage ID under C collation. Select documents whose closest passage is within cutoff. Expand each selected document to mechanism then checks, retaining exact original excerpts and actual sibling distances. Apply existing top3/3000 excerpt bytes/4000 serialized bytes bounds. A sibling may exceed the seed cutoff; disclose seed ID/distance separately. No labels in retrieval.
control: Replay title-context section retrieval at both cutoffs and original body-corpus lexical OR. Verify archived v2 raw SHA256, then exact query/input/source IDs/ranks/metadata and distance tolerance 0.000001. Stop on mismatch.

selection.minimum_mrr: unchanged lexical OR mean over ten nonempty relevance sets

stop: One measured development comparison only. Preserve failure/partial reports. No extra cutoff, candidate or metric substitution after inspecting results.
promotion: None automatically, even on development success. Runtime and its artifact acceptance remain unchanged.
